summary: THORChain halted swaps on ~10 chains (ETH, BTC, SOL...) after an Oct 31 Ethereum one-block reorg caused a 10 ETH payout from an empty vault; user returned funds, fixes in progress, trading live only on AVAX, BASE, RUNE, XRPL as of Nov 2. RUNE fell ~18% to ~$0.51, now ~$0.574. Momentum score 0.9 is a rebound from the drop, not news-driven.
catalyst_note: 2026-10-31/11-02: swaps halted after ETH reorg double-payout; fix pending
